feat_tournament_builder_desc: Create league, knockout, or hybrid formats in seconds. Automatic fixture generation and seeding.
feat_live_results_desc: Real-time score updates visible to everyone. Push notifications after every goal.
feat_group_stage_desc: Dynamic standings tables with configurable tiebreakers, points, and goal difference calculated automatically.
feat_player_stats_desc: Goals, assists, cards, ratings — everything is tracked automatically. Leaderboards updated after every match.
feat_smart_scheduling_desc: Conflict-free match scheduling. Reschedule match days in one click and notify everyone instantly.
feat_brackets_finals_desc: Bracket visualization with automatic seeding from the groups. One click to crown the champion.

feat_event_calendar_desc: Schedule trainings, matches, and meetings. Automatic notifications so no one misses a thing.

feat_match_management_desc: Call-ups, lineups, results, and stats. Full tracking of your team's performance.

testimonial_2_quote: Having attendance and payments in one place is incredible. Our players love the platform too.
testimonial_3_quote: We generated the fixture for 32 teams in seconds. The group stage and brackets work perfectly.
